notes.title: Improved and Fixed (Ver1.1.3)
notes.content:
* The server you are connecting to has been changed.

* Improved the way stage gimmicks are synchronized.

# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

tags.feature: * Improved the way stage gimmicks are synchronized.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.1.2)
notes.content:
* Fixed an issue where sprinting could be unintentionally canceled under certain conditions during online multiplayer.
# I am very sorry for the inconvenience caused by this bug. I am sincerely sorry.

* Fixed an issue where damage would be taken when returning to the starting point under certain conditions.

* Fixed an issue where you could not return from the Friend Match settings screen.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where sprinting could be unintentionally canceled under certain conditions during online multiplayer.
- Fixed an issue where damage would be taken when returning to the starting point under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue where you could not return from the Friend Match settings screen.

notes.title: Fixed & Improved (Ver 1.1.1)
notes.content:
* Fixed a problem where the dash would be unintentionally canceled during the dash.

* Camera work has been slightly improved.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

tags.bug: * Fixed a problem where the dash would be unintentionally canceled during the dash.

notes.title: Add high difficulty stages & clear bonus (Ver 1.1.0)
notes.content:
* The Extra stage has been added as a high difficulty stage.
# This stage is really difficult, so I recommend attacking it slowly and at your own pace.

* As a clearing bonus, a new mode will be opened when all stages are cleared.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

tags.feature: * The Extra stage has been added as a high difficulty stage.
* As a clearing bonus, a new mode will be opened when all stages are cleared.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.3)
notes.content:
* Fixed an issue that could cause a large decrease in Life at certain place.

* Fixed an issue where the viewpoint operation sensitivity setting values would differ depending on the PC spec.

* Fixed an issue that caused some gamepads to respond even when the stick was not tipped over.

* Fixed an issue that prevented players from going offline after a quick match or friend match, even if they selected single-player.

* Fixed an issue where the buttons could not be pressed on menu.

* Fixed an issue where during online multiplayer, if you select the same stage as the current stage on the stage selection screen when the game is over or after the game is cleared, the other players will not be displayed.

# The game will not match players with different versions.

tags.bug: * Fixed an issue that could cause a large decrease in Life at certain place.
* Fixed an issue where the viewpoint operation sensitivity setting values would differ depending on the PC spec.
* Fixed an issue that caused some gamepads to respond even when the stick was not tipped over.
* Fixed an issue that prevented players from going offline after a quick match or friend match, even if they selected single-player.
* Fixed an issue where the buttons could not be pressed on menu.

* Fixed an issue where during online multiplayer, if you select the same stage as the current stage on the stage selection screen when the game is over or after the game is cleared, the other players will not be displayed.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.2)
notes.content:
* Fixed a problem where the Life of your soap would also decrease when other soaps received a strong impact.

* Fixed an issue where the trails of other soaps would sometimes not disappear.

# The game will not match players with different versions.
